SessionId.description: Identity of one plugin run or tab.

description:
The token that authorizes one approved plan.

The token is bound to the plan hash, the session, the grant epoch, and an
expiry. A grant change invalidates every outstanding approval.

approved_by.description: Who approved. Always the user, never the agent.

grant_epoch.description: Grant epoch the approval is bound to.

plan_hash.description: Hash of the canonical plan the user approved.

session_id.description: Session the approval is bound to.
